Ki ong ka dei ka ktien shu thaw, Ne ’tien nangang pyllait jynthaw ; Ka jingshah jop ka long ka bor, H*u stad ba dap pura ki shkor ; Haba lynti jingim ka btuit, Jingkit bakhia, shadien syntuid : Da sham biang biang, da kyrshan skhem Hangno u don u maw baskhem : Lada ha thiep, khmat maw phi jam, Ne jur basyier, ba riat sham sham ; Lada sha lait thiep bran phi kam, Ne sha lait jur, phi mareh bran ; Phi jop namar phi iai kyrshan, Kam pher katno jingkit ka ban : Sha thong phin poi da jinglai shah, Lada phim sngap ka jingring pah ; Ka jingshah jop ka long kawei — I’u biiew ka btin ban jop pyrthei.
